symptom: describe page -> exec of FactoryManagement pages reported Replaced page and changed three settings: a check box's LabelPosition AfterControl became Default (ConversationalUI.TraceFiltering_Edit), a radio button group's RenderHorizontal false became true (TcConnector.TeamcenterConfiguration_NewEdit), and a show page button's NumberOfPagesToClose2 '1' became '' (SnowflakeRESTSQL.ConnectionDetails_NewEdit_Step2). mx check stays green on both sides; the page behaves differently.
file: sdk/pages (CheckBox.LabelPosition, PageClientAction.NumberOfPagesToClose); mdl/executor cmd_pages_builder_v3_widgets.go (LabelPosition, RenderHorizontal), cmd_pages_describe_parse.go + cmd_pages_describe_output.go (read and print both), cmd_pages_describe_action_settings.go (NumberOfPagesToClose in with (…)), page_action_settings.go, widget_native_props.go (MDL-WIDGET52 reads), validate_widgets.go (known props); mdl/visitor/visitor_action_settings.go (showPage kind, numeric value); grammar actionSettingV3 takes NUMBER_LITERAL; mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (SetLabelPosition, SetNumberOfPagesToClose2). Tests: cmd_pages_round_trip_settings_2106_test.go, visitor_show_page_close_2106_test.go, widget_write_round_trip_settings_2106_test.go
cause: None of the three had an MDL spelling. The writer wrote the default each time: NumberOfPagesToClose2 hard-coded to "", LabelPosition never set, and RenderHorizontal derived from a RenderDirection nothing ever filled, so every rewritten radio button group became horizontal.
insight: **A value-only BSON diff of the first exec, swept over a whole app, separates real losses from unexpressible formatting.** Of FactoryManagement's 14 'Replaced' pages, these three change behaviour; the other eleven differ in values MDL cannot state (TabIndex, trailing newlines in DynamicClasses, XPath whitespace, condition order, an inherited attribute's declaring entity, a null SourceVariable key, an unused placeholder parameter), which a canon carry handles separately. A model field the writer reads but no builder sets (RadioButtons.RenderDirection) is a silent default: grep each writer input for a builder that assigns it. Controls: reverting each of the ten edits fails its test; a new page using all three builds with mx check 0 errors on the Agent Builder Starter App; TraceFiltering_Edit and ConnectionDetails_NewEdit_Step2 now report Unchanged page.
